commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The attendance is 12868.
90+2' The game has begun to heat up. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Rico leaves the pitch and Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) comes on.
85' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
84' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Jorge de Frutos.
84' Substitution. Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Sergio Camello.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' This is a yellow card! Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
80' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Luis Milla and he is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Getafe).
77' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Sergio Camello was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
74' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Isi Palazon.
74' It's time for a substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Unai Lopez.
74' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' Omar Alderete (Getafe) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Stole Dimitrievski makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

68' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle after Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
67' The total number of attempts is 8:3. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
66' The game has come to an end for Yellu Santiago. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
64' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Oscar Trejo is replaced by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
63' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
62' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Getafe.
60' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by David Soria.
58' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play. There is a free kick near the sideline to Getafe.
56' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
53' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
51' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' The ball spins out to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the left post.
49' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

47' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a switch. Juanmi Latasa is coming on in place of Jaime Mata (Getafe) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is replaced by Jose Angel Carmona.
46' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jaime Mata (Getafe). Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
44' Rough tackle by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Getafe.
42' Diego Rico (Getafe) trips an opposition player and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a foul. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick near the side line.
40' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
39' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
38' Diego Rico (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
36' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez who sees an offensive foul. A free kick is awarded to Getafe.
33' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' A cross into the box from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
29' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
27' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe get a free kick.
26' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
18' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece. Getafe win a free kick.
17' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
16' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez stops the game and makes a call. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a free kick.
12' Jaime Mata (Getafe) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Jaime Mata (Getafe) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Stole Dimitrievski.
9' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
7' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
7' One of the Rayo Vallecano players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
6' Fine attempt! Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
5' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
4' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
4' Diego Rico (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
3' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' A player from Getafe commits a rough challenge. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
